verdict.rationale: Databricks documents that BI tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Sigma can query metric views/dashboards without custom glue (databricks-docs-33, databricks-docs-9), implying standard connector support for common BI stacks. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit JDBC/ODBC driver documentation, connection setup guides, or independent confirmation that these drivers work seamlessly. Missing for 10: explicit JDBC/ODBC driver docs, connection-string/setup guides, and hands-on independent verification of BI-tool connectivity.
